steps.summary: Every screen's look and wording is written down, and the build is planned as 7 small steps.
The manager signs in, adds and removes staff; new staff choose their own password on first sign-in.
The manager plans and publishes weeks; staff see their own shifts and ask for swaps; the manager approves or turns them down.
Everyone lands on their own screen after signing in, and every screen uses the café's own wording.
